items.quote: Several respondents noted that Karin Thalberly spearheaded the migration of core services to the cloud at the national level.
Direct reports said that Karin Thalberly set the direction for the innovation lab's experiments on service design across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Karin handled the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics competently within their team.
Peers observed that Karin Thalberly was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of root cause analysis of recurring service failures.
Karin took ownership of coaching and mentoring junior officers and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Karin was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of cost savings across procurement.
Karin set the direction for the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs across the public service.
Direct reports said that Karin managed reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth for their unit.
Peers observed that Karin Thalberly led the rethink of subsidy rules for elderly households across the department.
